answers.core: Not sure if addons can do that.
answers.workaround: For now you can use generic `GDScript` exported variable and use quick load window to find the desired script. It's the fastest way. Or you can also make a resource (tres) file for every resource script you have but that's tedious and useless if you just want to use one method from the script and not have customizable variables.
